newsitem.title: BOTSWANA: Avis Holding to list in Botswana and Namibia.
newsitem.headline: Avis Holding to list in Botswana and Namibia.

text.p: The southern African car rental operation Avis Holdings will list on the Botswana and Namibian stock exchanges this week, a Botswana exchange official said on Monday.
The official said the company would list on the Namibian bourse on Tuesday and a day later on the Botswana Stock Exchange (BSE).
Avis is already listed on the Johannesburg Stock Exchange (JSE) and will list 137,525,600 shares on the BSE at the pula equivalent of the closing price on the JSE on Tuesday.
The shares were trading on the JSE at R7.20 (5.80 pula) on Monday.
The official said Avis would list the same number of shares on the Nambian Stock Exchange (NSE).
This will be the fourth dual listing on the Botswana exchange this year. Avis follows De Beers, Regent Africa Undervalued Asset Fund and McCarthy Retail.
The JSE-listed insurance group Forbes will list 215,145,200 shares on the BSE on June 21.
